proof_checks: H2=0 forbids effective horizontal divisors by positive intersection with a Kähler regular torus fibre. Polar-divisor and proper connected-fibre arguments identify the entire meromorphic function field with C(t).

Every biholomorphism therefore preserves the algebraic-reduction fibration up to a Möbius map, and preserves the intrinsic divisor gcd at every multiple fibre; the distinct coprime nontrivial orders identify the individual caps.
Good-cap central source-line order t and invariant one-form give full period image (1/t)Z+(tau/m+y*kappa)Z. Bezout identities give both inclusions, with m*kappa integral.
The reduced-cap cyclic generator H=B^x A^y has exact identities H^m=B and H^n=A. Equivariant normalization gives the displayed P1-bundle and its full Albanese lattice, without changing by an isogeny.
For every nontrivial root-of-unity phase, Q(j(Q)-j(zeta Q)) tends to nonzero 1-zeta^-1. The finitely many phases allow a common sufficiently small punctured parameter disc.

All 30 F53 branches have product of local removed factors equal to b, including a-dependent central line orders, the quadratic I1star component exchange, and order-one slots. K35 supplies the exact sharp cover.

OS49 mixed row: applying -da+3db to the four marked columns gives (T,0,-1,3), while n(e_gamma-e_u)+d_delta*delta gives (n*T+3*d_delta)/m. For n=+/-1 the full period lattice is Z+Z*(T+3*n*d_delta)/m, hence exponent 1/k. K37 supplies sharpness.
scope: All 30 fixed-source canonical scalar branches and the separately constructed component-supported OS49 branches, for sufficiently small nonzero scalar. Endpoint biholomorphism minimality is proved; mapping classes of arbitrary additional endpoint automorphisms are not assigned.
